The '''Cells of the Lords of the Infinite''' was the name given to a volcanic cavern that was one of the sections of [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. A lava pool was located in the center of the cave, and the upper part of [[Megasecurity Ward 23]] sat on an outcropping in the middle of the lake. A number of vaults were located in the cavern and held powerful prisoners, such as [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Subject 13]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cells of the Lords of the Infinite appears a subregion of the Tomb on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
